title: 2094. Finding 3-Digit Even Numbers

examples.explanation: All the possible integers that follow the requirements are in the output array. Notice that there are no odd integers or integers with leading zeros.
The same digit can be used as many times as it appears in digits. In this example, the digit 8 is used twice each time in 288, 828, and 882.
No even integers can be formed using the given digits.
